children: GREENWICH, Conn., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Leverage Shares by Themes is pleased to announce the launch of SKHQ, the Leverage Shares 1X Short SK Hynix Daily ETF, available for trading beginning September 2, 2026, on Cboe.
SKHQ seeks to provide -100% of the daily performance of SK Hynix, before fees and expenses, giving active traders a new way to express short-term views on SK Hynix through an ETF structure.

The launch builds on Leverage Shares US's existing lineup of SK Hynix-focused leveraged ETFs, expanding the range of tools available to investors seeking tactical exposure to SK Hynix. With SKHQ, traders can now access -1X daily inverse exposure, providing greater flexibility to express different market views and risk preferences.

The addition reflects Leverage Shares US's broader approach to building a comprehensive suite of tactical exchange-traded products. By offering multiple exposure profiles tied to the same underlying asset, Leverage Shares US aims to give knowledgeable, active investors more choice in how they implement short-term trading strategies.

SKHQ complements our existing SK Hynix-focused leveraged ETFs with a -1X daily option, giving active traders another way to express their views on SK Hynix within the Leverage Shares US lineup."
